before.requirement: Preserve double pipes as spoiler delimiters inside a table cell.
before.reason: The before collector makes pipe marks available as single-character table boundaries, and the complete before inline dispatch has no spoiler handling.

after.requirement: With table and spoiler parsing enabled, preserve double pipes inside a cell as spoiler delimiters while single pipes delimit cells.
after.reason: The collector creates two-character spoiler marks before handling single pipes. The table pass selects only unresolved one-character pipes as boundaries. Each resulting cell runs normal inline processing, which pairs spoiler marks and emits spoiler spans.

claims.reason: The frozen spoiler-in-table capability was unavailable before. After the change, the same old harness has a direct input route to it. This assessment is limited to claim o-c49a850503387666; it does not establish coverage of the other selected changes.
